verdict.rationale: Puzzle explicitly markets QuickBooks migration ('Migrate from QuickBooks without lifting a finger or losing your client's data', 'Switch in minutes. Free migration.'), directly addressing historical books migration without data loss for founders switching accounting systems. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of transaction-level fidelity during migration, detail on which source systems beyond QuickBooks are supported, and documented handling of complex historical data edge cases (multi-entity, custom categories).
